description: This file defines the PersistableManufacturer class, which extends ManufacturerEntity and implements Serializable, including a list of descriptions with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: PersistableManufacturer
classes.description: A serializable class representing a manufacturer with a list of descriptions, extending ManufacturerEntity.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of ManufacturerDescription objects for this manufacturer.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of ManufacturerDescription objects associated with this manufacturer.
